method: Numerical comparison only: actual encoded30fps cue-midpoint JPEG against exact full-source/burned-caption composition. Actual SRT midpoints, no speech interpolation or automatic visual approval.

frames.caption_text: In Unit, open Deployments and use Open to review active assignments.
This example opens TRAINING ONLY, Academy field operations.
Read the deployment name and reference before continuing, especially when
several crews share a vehicle.
A fire or EMS crew can use this workspace to organize a deployment;
the information shown here belongs to a fictional software exercise.
Inside the deployment, the Time tab shows the Date, the selected
crew, and Reports this day.
Here, the displayed date is October twenty-sixth and the Engine Fifty-One
crew already has a Draft report.
Read that existing report before starting another one.
Its deployment roster is separate from the apparatus staffing
seats used for incident response.
Scroll through the existing entries and compare the From and
To values, Unpaid break, and agency supplied meals and accommodation.
The summary shows eight hours for the unit and eight for Boden, totaling
sixteen hours across subjects.
These are existing training values.
Apply to crew and Add entry are separate editing choices; we leave the time
entries and allowances as they are.
In the Engine Fifty-One row, use the note field beneath the allowance switches.
The example note identifies this as a training walkthrough and
says it makes no actual hours, work, expense, or payment claim.
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - Unit app walkthrough note on this fictional draft. No actual hours, work, expense, or payment claim.

frames.caption_text: Check the subject name before typing: a unit note and a personnel
note belong to different entries.
This edit changes the unit note while preserving the other displayed values.
Scroll below the entries and choose Save entries to store the note.
Submit report is a different action, and the Signatures section still says
that the crew boss has not signed and no agency signature is recorded.
required_labels: Not signed by the crew boss yet.

frames.caption_text: Saving an explanatory draft note does not submit the report
or provide an attestation.
Keep those later actions separate when reviewing a practice draft.
After saving, this draft shows a long-shift warning for each subject
required_labels: A long shift has no break recorded. — Wallace Boden (TRAINING Boden)
A long shift has no break recorded. — Engine 51 (TRAINING Engine 51)

frames.caption_text: because no break is recorded.
Read these warnings before treating a report as complete;
this example does not resolve them.
Reopening the draft shows the same training note in the Engine Fifty-One row.

frames.caption_text: That readback verifies the stored note, while the report remains Draft and the
existing time values remain visible.
On Time, My time displays a message that this time is already on report number one.
required_labels: This time is already on report #1 for this day.

frames.caption_text: Use that reference to find existing coverage instead
of creating duplicate time.
Whole deployment shows a separate scope with Start time report.
That button would start another report; it is not an automatic total of every crew.
In this review, we inspect the scope and leave the button untouched.
The Expenses tab shows an empty day and a New expense form.
The visible fields are Amount in U.S.
dollars, Description, and City, with Fuel selected as the expense type.
Take photo and Choose photo are attachment choices.
We inspect these controls without opening a camera or adding an expense.
A receipt, reimbursement, or payment is not demonstrated by an empty form.
In Usage, confirm the selected resource and phase before reading Start odometer,
End odometer, Engine hours, and Fuel.
The first view shows miles and gallons.
The unit controls can switch the empty form to kilometers and liters.
This demonstrates the displayed unit choices, without recording a reading
or converting measured quantities.
Add reading remains separate from reviewing the form.
On F-42, this existing item says Needs Review, with eight
errors and two warnings.
Validate and Draft F-42 from time reports are available actions, but
neither is performed in this review.
The page explains that the draft uses submitted time reports and submission
required_labels: The F-42 is drafted from submitted time reports and checked against the CAL OES portal rules. Submission stays a manual, audited step on the web.
